pass_a_gloss: Soul laid down for brethren; tribulation chain; Ephesian beasts; Germany crux flagged.
pass_b_english: 'Herein we know love, that he laid down his soul for us; and we ought to lay down our souls for the brethren.' (1 John 3:16) And tribulation works patience, patience proof, proof hope — and hope confoundeth not. 'If after the manner of men I fought beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me?' (Romans 5:3–5) As Paul fought, so we — destroyed(?) in Germany(?) for the Gospel — shall conquer with Christ. For 'as the sufferings of Christ abound unto us, so through Christ aboundeth our comfort also.' (1 Corinthians 15:32) (2 Corinthians 1:5)
